title: Integrated approaches to understanding animal exploitation and dairying in the Central European Early Neolithic: a case study from Ludwinowo 7 (Kuyavia, Poland; c. 5250–5000 cal BC)
version: Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology, DOI 10.3389/fearc.2023.1187087. Author list abbreviated.
lineage: Integrated analysis combines cattle mortality profiles and tooth isotopes with ceramics. The tooth isotopes build on Kendall et al. 2019, and the sherd results include Salque et al. 2013 and the expanded 2019 assemblage.

passages.note: Cattle age and isotopic profiles support mixed meat and milk husbandry with seasonal calving. The integrated evidence identifies cows as the probable main milk source.
